rules.title: Project Root Structure
rules.check: Projects MUST follow standard folder layout at root level.
rules.good_example:
src/
  features/
  shared/
  main.ts
tests/
  unit/
  integration/
dist/
package.json
tsconfig.json
rules.rationale: Standard structure enables quick navigation and tooling configuration.

rules.title: Source Organization
rules.check: Source code MUST be in src/ with clear separation of features and shared code.
rules.good_example:
src/
  features/
    orders/
    users/
    payments/
  shared/
    utils/
    logger/
    config/
  main.ts
  app.ts
rules.rationale: Feature/shared separation enforces proper module boundaries.

rules.title: File Naming with Suffix
rules.check: Files MUST use kebab-case with purpose suffix indicating type.  **Standard Suffixes** - .service.ts - Business logic services - .controller.ts - HTTP controllers/handlers - .repository.ts - Data access layer - .types.ts - Type definitions - .schema.ts - Validation schemas (zod, etc.) - .guard.ts - Auth/validation guards - .middleware.ts - Express/Fastify middleware - .test.ts or .spec.ts - Test files - .mock.ts - Mock implementations - .constants.ts - Constant values
rules.rationale: Suffixes immediately communicate file purpose without opening it.

rules.title: Type File Organization
rules.check: Types MUST be organized by scope: local types co-located, shared types in types/ folder.
rules.bad_example:
types/
  everything.ts  // All types in one file
rules.good_example:
src/
  features/orders/
    order.types.ts          // Order-specific types
    order.service.ts        // Uses local types
  shared/
    types/
      common.types.ts       // Shared types (Result, Pagination)
      api.types.ts          // API response types
      index.ts              // Re-exports public types
rules.rationale: Co-located types reduce navigation; shared types prevent duplication.

rules.title: Barrel Export Files
rules.check: Use index.ts only for explicit public API exports. No export * patterns.
rules.rationale: Explicit exports define clear module boundaries and prevent accidental exposure.

rules.title: Test File Co-location
rules.check: Unit tests SHOULD be co-located with source or in parallel __tests__ directory.  **Pattern A - Co-located** `` src/features/orders/   order.service.ts   order.service.test.ts   order.controller.ts   order.controller.test.ts `  **Pattern B - Parallel Directory** ` src/features/orders/   order.service.ts   __tests__/     order.service.test.ts ``
rules.rationale: Co-located tests are easier to find and maintain alongside source code.

rules.title: Integration Test Separation
rules.check: Integration and E2E tests MUST be in separate top-level folders.
rules.good_example:
tests/
  unit/              # Or co-located with source
  integration/
    database.test.ts
    api.test.ts
  e2e/
    user-journey.test.ts
  fixtures/
    test-data.json
  helpers/
    test-utils.ts
rules.rationale: Separation enables different test configurations and run strategies.

rules.title: Import Organization
rules.check: Imports MUST be organized in groups: external, internal, relative.
rules.rationale: Organized imports are easier to scan and maintain.

rules.title: Type-Only Imports
rules.check: Use import type for type-only imports to enable better tree-shaking.
rules.bad_example:
import { Order, OrderService } from './order';
// If Order is only used as type, OrderService gets imported unnecessarily
rules.good_example:
import type { Order } from './order.types';
import { OrderService } from './order.service';
rules.rationale: Type-only imports are erased at compile time and don't affect bundle.

rules.title: Entry Point Files
rules.check: Entry points (index.ts, main.ts, app.ts) MUST only contain orchestration, not logic.
rules.rationale: Clean entry points are testable and clearly show application structure.

rules.title: Shared Folder Structure
rules.check: Shared code MUST be organized by concern, not dumped in generic folders.
rules.bad_example:
shared/
  utils.ts       // Everything dumped here
  helpers.ts     // Vague naming
  common.ts      // Catch-all
rules.good_example:
shared/
  config/
    index.ts
    env.schema.ts
  logger/
    index.ts
    logger.service.ts
  http/
    http.client.ts
    http.types.ts
  validation/
    validators.ts
  errors/
    app.error.ts
    error.types.ts
rules.rationale: Organized shared code is discoverable and maintainable.

rules.title: Package.json Configuration
rules.check: All package.json files MUST be explicit with complete metadata.
rules.rationale: Complete package.json enables proper publishing, tooling, and documentation.

rules.title: Monorepo Package Structure
rules.check: Monorepos MUST have clear package boundaries with apps/ and packages/ separation.
rules.good_example:
apps/
  web/
    package.json
    src/
  api/
    package.json
    src/
packages/
  shared/
    package.json
    src/
  ui/
    package.json
    src/
package.json
turbo.json
rules.rationale: Clear separation enables independent versioning and deployment.

rules.title: Declaration Files
rules.check: Custom type declarations MUST be in @types/ or types/ folder with .d.ts extension.
rules.good_example:
src/
  @types/
    global.d.ts           // Global type extensions
    env.d.ts              // Environment type declarations
    express.d.ts          // Module augmentations
  types/
    api.types.ts          // Application types (not declarations)
rules.rationale: Separate declaration files from runtime type definitions.

rules.title: No mixed case file names (use kebab-case only)
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No mixed case file names (use kebab-case only)

rules.title: No default exports
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No default exports

rules.title: No `export *` barrel exports
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No `export *` barrel exports

rules.title: No deeply nested folders (max 4 levels in src)
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No deeply nested folders (max 4 levels in src)

rules.title: No `utils.ts` or `helpers.ts` as catch-all
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No `utils.ts` or `helpers.ts` as catch-all

rules.title: No logic in index.ts files
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No logic in index.ts files

rules.title: No circular imports between modules
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No circular imports between modules

rules.title: No relative imports crossing feature boundaries
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No relative imports crossing feature boundaries

rules.title: No minimal package.json without required fields
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No minimal package.json without required fields

rules.title: No business logic in entry point files
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No business logic in entry point files
